paper_operational_criterion.criterion: Falling voltage dU/dt < 0 together with cell-surface temperature rate dT/dt > 10 K/s.
paper_operational_criterion.qualification: This is a temperature-and-voltage-derived endpoint, not an independently timed video label. Sensor mapping and derivative processing must be specified before scoring.

diagnostic_not_an_onset_label.operation: First interpolated T1 crossing of the 436.6 C value reported in paper Section 3.1.1
diagnostic_not_an_onset_label.interpretation: A first absolute-temperature crossing does not reproduce the paper's change-of-trajectory or combined derivative criterion. Do not use this number as a verified runaway onset or video synchronization anchor.
